title: Chicken Keema Matar
equip: Instant Pot, Philips hand blender (chopper attachment)

items.n: onion, finely chopped in the chopper
green chillies, slit lengthwise (left whole so they can be removed)

items.sub: 150ml tomato purée | 1 onion-tomato masala freezer cube (then halve the onion and skip the tomato)

steps.x: Set the Instant Pot to Sauté (High). Heat the ghee, add cumin, bay leaf, cloves and cinnamon, and stir for 1 min until fragrant.
Add the onion and cook for 6 min, stirring often, until light golden. Add the ginger-garlic paste and green chillies and cook 1 min until the raw smell is gone.
Add the tomato and all ground spices. Cook 3 min until the tomato softens and the masala looks jammy. If it catches, add a splash of the water.

Add the chicken mince and break it up thoroughly with a spatula for 3 min until no large lumps remain. This step decides the texture, because lumps set under pressure. Add the water and scrape the bottom completely so you don't get a burn warning.
Lock the lid with the vent on Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 5 min, then natural release for 10 min and release the rest.

Set to Sauté. Stir in the frozen peas and cook 3 min, uncovered, until the peas are hot and the keema is semi-dry. Turn off, then stir in the lemon juice, coriander and mint. Remove the green chillies before portioning your daughter's share.

notes: Approx. per portion: 400 kcal, 38g protein (keema only). Serve with 1 roti or 120g cooked rice.
Fridge: 4 days in Glasslock. Freezer: 3 months.
Reheat: microwave 2 min, stir, then 1 min more until steaming hot.
For wraps: cook 5 min longer on Sauté in step 6 until fully dry.
Spicier adult portion: stir a pinch of chilli powder or chopped green chilli into your own bowl.
Source uses 2 tbsp ghee for less meat; 1 tbsp is plenty with 700g mince.
